text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Right, if you don't do this right, you'll 
repeat my mistakes. I don't want you to 
end up peaking as "just pretty good."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Come to think of it, Ryan also..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I lost! Well, a big part of it was 
just that I wasn't good enough, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: (Ryan-oneesama... I...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(I know... And I haven't forgotten, not 
for a single moment...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Sister Ryan and Dober said they 
would be cheering from the stands~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Satsuki Sho. Mejiro Bright 
softly let her gaze wander into the air...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Sister Ryan spoke rather 
refreshingly about her defeat in the 
Satsuki Sho, but~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
How she truly feels is a little different, 
you know. On that day... I was secretly 
watching...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
NGGGGHHHH AAAAAAGHHH!! Why?! Why can't I 
just...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, Grandmother...! You placed 
so much hope in me...! Ever since the day 
I was born! Ever since...! And yet!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaahhhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I... did not cry. As much as I wanted to 
weep, I kept my eyes wide and my ears 
perked...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I engraved that sight into my memory. So 
that I would never forget it until the day 
I could wash away that bitterness on your 
behalf.
choice_data_list: A day to water them instead, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Today is the day. That is why I 
sought Ryan-oneesama's guidance no matter 
what..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to clear away my frustration with 
the running style handed down directly to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
For an ordinary Umamusume, the chance to 
challenge the Triple Crown comes only once 
in a lifetime. But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Sister Ryan will have a second chance. 
After all, she has me chasing after her~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Who to invite as a coach? I thought it 
happened by chance, but it seems I was 
gently guided to this point.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In order to avenge Mejiro Ryan's regret, 
Mejiro Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
When I was little, Sister Ryan said this 
to me:

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Who's to say she'll never run fast? She's 
not even grown up yet—there's no way 
anyone could know for sure.

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"So there's nothing to worry about. The 
future is definitely bright, so let's just 
go at our own pace."

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright has her own way of running. Right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Which is why I shall run as the me that 
dear sister Ryan believed in~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer, will I be able to ...shine today?
choice_data_list:
You can shine! Let's do it, with your own 
running!

You can shine! Let's do it, with your own 
running!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes~. Together with you, who walks this 
path alongside me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Today is my chance at revenge~. I shall 
give you plenty to laugh about~.
